product_identity_field: Unique product URL from the supplied QC sheet; multiple SKUs under one URL count once
production_status: In progress; image references only from GitHub. Gallery images labeled OK-REVIEW-RECOMMENDED or REVIEW-FAMILY-IMAGE are manually inspected rather than automatically excluded.
source_policy: GitHub repository reference images only. Sheet product links may be used for target specifications.
reference_policy_note: Per updated user request, missing references do not exclude products from the queue. Any image generated without an adequate reference must be identified as an unverified approximation unusable until matched against the actual product.
target_completed_definition: 2000 unique QC-sheet product URLs have generated files; this does not mean QC approval or 2000 physically different designs.
